consumption_rule: The first process invocation attempt consumes this authority whether it passes, fails, or is interrupted. No retry is authorized.

fresh_path.exclusive_capture: The sealed wrapper creates claim, receipt, child stderr, and wrapper status using os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL and never removes or overwrites them.
fresh_path.initial_condition: fresh_parent must not exist before staging
fresh_path.package_condition: copy only the exact 15-member r3 source package plus SOURCE_MANIFEST.json, then reproduce verify_source.py before the one permitted invocation
fresh_path.receipt_condition: The sealed shell-free wrapper exclusively creates receipt_path and connects it directly to the sole child process stdout; no shell redirection or overwrite operation is permitted.
fresh_path.review_condition: copy the exact sealed r3 independent review package into review_root and reproduce verify_review.py with its externally pinned manifest before the one permitted invocation

staging_and_launch_order: Confirm fresh_parent is absent, then create it exactly once with package and review child directories.
Copy and independently authenticate the exact r3 deployment closure into package_root.
Copy and independently authenticate this exact sealed review closure into review_root.
Use a network-disabled executor with no Qwen payload mounted or accessed.
Set cwd and CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES exactly as frozen, then exec command.argv once without a shell.
The wrapper atomically and persistently claims the attempt before validating or spawning, then exclusively captures the sole child stdout/stderr and validates the JSON receipt.
Do not retry. Validate receipt_path with verify_preflight_receipt.py without invoking the preflight again.
